steps.text: In a panic, Jessica reaches for the handgun at her waist. But fear keeps her fingers saddled atop the holster, unable to bend.
She smells something vaguely rank upon the wind.
Don't do anything rash, now.
From the thicket, a hunter walks into Jessica's line of sight, smoking gun in hand and with a wide-brimmed hat covering his eyes.
She turns and looks behind her to see the body of a wild beast lying in the snow, blood still flowing from the wound in its head.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: You ought to keep your wits about you here.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Thank you... for saving me.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Just passing by.
The elderly man stows his gun and walks straight towards the beast's body.
He draws a knife and slices open its stomach. Clean and precise, to keep the blood from spilling out.
He then sticks both hands into its belly and lets out a long sigh.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: It's so damn cold around here.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Excuse me, sir, but are you a local hunter?

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Suppose so.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Do you know how to get to Davistown?

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: ...The hell are you going there for?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm meeting up with my teammates.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: You ain't alone?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Well, my team split up to rescue a hostage from some bandits, but afterward, I broke my communicator and got lost in the woods.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: A hostage? Who?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: An elderly Forte man.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: ...Didn't expect it'd be you people.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Alright then, follow me.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Wh-Where are we going?

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Didn't you say you were heading for Davistown?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Umm, but...

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Don't say I didn't offer.
The old man pays her no more heed. He stands up to sling the carcass over his shoulders and briskly walks deeper into the forest.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: W-Wait up!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hrmm... You sure about leaving Jessica all alone out there?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I know you're worried, and so am I. But after fighting by her side for so many years, I trust that she's perfectly capable of handling herself.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I'm just worried there are more bandits out there. A couple of stragglers, sure, but what if they've got a whole band of reinforcements?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Jessica's been through much worse than a bunch of thugs.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Whether it's a rain of arrows whizzing past her scalp, blades nicking her throat...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Or surroundings choked with active Originium, where even a single crack in her protective gear would be immediately evident...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Each and every time, she completes the mission. Without our support, and without the company's supervision.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: She may be on her own, but she never fails to deliver results.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...I can't deny that.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: But I'm sure you also know that she comes back every time with red, swollen eyes. So before she returns, someone has to be there for her when she's bawling her eyes out, right?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What do those puffy eyes mean? They mean that she's wiped her tears before coming to see us. She doesn't want anyone to see her crying.

spans.text: What do those puffy eyes mean? They mean that she's wiped her tears before coming to see us. She doesn't

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Yeah, she's only twenty-three...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yes, twenty-three. And two-and-a-half of those last three years have been spent on the battlefield.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Excuse me, but did an explosion just go off nearby?

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I could swear I heard something... Pretty sure I wasn't imagining it.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: It was a tree, not an explosion.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: A tree?

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: If it gets too cold in the forest, the sap inside expands as it freezes, causing the trunk to burst.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: From a distance, it sounded... a bit like a firefight.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: What are you, anyway? Soldier? Merc?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I've been a mercenary for almost five years now.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Family in debt or something?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No... I just... didn't want to always be sheltered by my family name. I don't want to follow the path that they laid out for me...

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: So you went and became a merc?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Y-Yes...

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Hmph. So, what're you looking for on the battlefield? Fame? Fortune? Or glory?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: None of the above. I want to eliminate crises, resolve conflicts, and protect those in dangerous situations...

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Huh... So there are mercs who do that kinda stuff. News to me.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sir... We're no ordinary mercenary group. We're...

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Let me remind you, Jessica. You're a mercenary. This is about business, not duty.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: We...

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Alright, enough of that. Don't give me your whole spiel.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Sorry to bother you two, but are you talking about that 'seasoned' mercenary with five years of combat experience?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Yeah. Why, got anything to add, Laura?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: You two have worked with Jessica a lot longer than me, so you've got a much better grasp of her abilities and limitations than I do, right?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What, so you think she can handle it on her own?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Of course. Captain Liskarm is right – she's been to far more dangerous places over the last three years.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: While I can't help but worry when I think about that crybaby side of her, we all know she's going to be perfectly fine. Am I wrong?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: She doesn't know that.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Yeah, she's the only one...

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: But maybe she just needs a chance. Just one chance to see her own worth.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And you're saying that this is her opportunity?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Uh... I wouldn't go that far...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: S-Sir... Excuse me, sir!

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: You're awful noisy, young lady.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I, uhh, didn't mean to bother you... But if you could please take a look over there?
Jessica points to a trap next to a tree in the distance.
There, a beastcub's forelimbs are tightly clamped between metal teeth. The cub whines as blood seeps out from the trap's steel bite.
After the old hunter takes notice, he sets down the beast carcass, walks over to the tree, unties the trap, and frees the cub.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: It's just a cub... Maybe we can let it go. If its mother is in the area, we could take a quick look around.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Also, I heard that during the winter, hunters will often let mothers and cubs go so that the pack can reproduce...

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Its mother is right here.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You mean... the beast you just killed?

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: I've seen this female with her cubs a few times before.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Now, the mother's been shot to death, and the cub stepped in some sloppily-placed trap, so its pelt is all ruined.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: So... what should we do with it?

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Wring its neck. Put it out of its misery.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: How could you say that?!

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: What else? It won't last long on a broken leg with no mother.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: You wanna leave it here to die a slow death, you won't hear me complaining.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...So, there's no way for it to survive?

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Could you please hand it to me then...?

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: You want to finish the job? Be my guest.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Shh... It'll be alright, little fella... Everything will be alright.
Jessica holds the cub in her arms and gently runs her fingers down its fur.
She doesn't do anything else. She patiently waits for the cub's whines to gradually fade away until they disappear completely.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I couldn't save it, but at least... I can let it go in a warm embrace.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: Mercs doing hospice care, huh? That's another first for me.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Do you mind if I leave it here? I think... the mother is a good enough catch on its own.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: What, you want me to bury it for you, too? Hold a funeral while we're at it?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No... Every animal in the forest is hungry during the winter. If we leave it here... maybe one of them can have a good meal.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I might be a bit of softy, but... that doesn't mean I'm completely oblivious.

steps.name: Seasoned Hunter
steps.text: If you get it, then try to keep up, Miss Mercenary. I'm guessing you don't wanna get lost in the woods again.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: The wind's cleared the fog... Sir, did you bring us here just to get a view of Davistown?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: ...When I was little, I loved running to the high places near the plate, just to get a good look at the town I lived in.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What was it like back then?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Livelier, more glamorous... More full of life.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: As for now... Well, there's no going back. No turning back the clock.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Brrrr... It's freakin' cold. Can't believe they shipped us off to a place like this.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Franka...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What's on your mind?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: I was just... thinking about Jessica again.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What about her? Didn't you say you weren't worried?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: ...I was thinking about that 'opportunity' we were talking about.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh, you mean the chance for her to see her own worth?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Who knows? Maybe one day... it'll come to her in a gust of wind. A freaking cold one, so cold it makes her shiver all over.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: But it'll sweep away all the fog before her eyes, and everything will become as clear as day.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I just hope that what she sees then... won't be anything like what we're looking at.
Amidst the dispersing fog, huge tracks formed of fallen trees and broken branches can be seen winding down the hillside towards the center of the valley.
At their end is an abandoned plate.
Despite the distance, everyone can clearly see an energy tower rising from the middle of it, feebly wheezing out puffy white breaths.
Like a dying patient, struggling for air.
